meta.name: academic-pptx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or improve a presentation for an academic context — conference papers, seminar talks, thesis defenses, grant briefings, lab meetings, invited lectures, or any presentation where the audience will evaluate reasoning and evidence. Triggers include: 'conference talk', 'seminar slides', 'thesis defense', 'research presentation', 'academic deck', 'academic presentation'. Also triggers when the user asks to 'make slides' in combination with academic content (e.g., 'make slides for my paper on X', 'create a presentation for my dissertation defense', 'build a deck for my grant proposal'). This skill governs CONTENT and STRUCTURE decisions. For the technical work of creating or editing the .pptx file itself, also read the pptx SKILL.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为学术场景创建或优化演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为论文、答辩或学术会议制作专业演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Create or improve presentations for academic contexts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create professional slides for papers, defenses, or academic conferences

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照学术演示规范来规划幻灯片的内容和结构，包括使用行动标题、每张幻灯片只放一个核心观点，并确保引用规范。
howto.when: 当你要求制作或改进学术演示文稿时触发，例如提到“会议报告”、“研讨会幻灯片”、“论文答辩”、“研究演示”等关键词，或要求“为我的论文制作幻灯片”。

say.text: 帮我为我的会议论文制作幻灯片。
say.note: Claude 会先确定演示类型，然后规划大纲。

say.text: 改进我论文答辩的幻灯片结构。
say.note: Claude 会检查行动标题和论证逻辑。

say.text: 为我的基金申请创建演示文稿。
say.note: Claude 会应用结构化论证模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will plan the content and structure of presentations according to academic presentation standards, including using action titles, one insight per slide, and proper citations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create or improve an academic presentation, e.g., mentioning 'conference talk', 'seminar slides', 'thesis defense', 'research presentation', or asking to 'make slides' for academic content.

say_en.text: Create slides for my conference paper.
say_en.note: Claude will identify the presentation type and plan an outline.

say_en.text: Improve the structure of my thesis defense slides.
say_en.note: Claude will check action titles and argument flow.

say_en.text: Build a deck for my grant proposal.
say_en.note: Claude will apply structured argument mode.
